page.title: Document Workspace
page.purpose: Let an operator build a long-form document from converged sections, with feasibility known before work starts and the blast radius of a change visible before it is made.

priorities.statement: Whether this document can be generated at all, before any section is attempted
Which section is active and what context it is carrying
Which already-committed sections a change would invalidate
How coherent the assembled document is, as measured numbers

elements.name: Outline
elements.description: Sections in order with per-section status.

elements.name: Section variations
elements.description: The active section's candidate set, reusing the Variation Board contract.

elements.name: Context carried
elements.description: What this section carried forward and what was summarized.

elements.name: Feasibility
elements.description: The static check verdict against the profile's worst-case section.

elements.name: Coherence
elements.description: Cross-section repetition and style drift as numbers.

elements.name: Downstream impact
elements.description: Which committed sections carried a changed section's text and would be invalidated by rerolling it.

elements.name: Assemble
elements.description: Assembles committed sections into ordered text plus structure.

states.description: The outline candidate set is open and no section exists yet.
The outline is committed and sections are being converged.
The profile's worst-case section exceeds the resolved model's context window; generation is refused before any work begins.
An already-committed section is being rerolled and downstream sections carried its text.
Every section is committed and the document is assembled.
A new document with no outline yet.
Data for this surface is in flight; skeleton structure is shown rather than a blank frame.
Some data resolved and some did not; what resolved stays usable and what failed is named rather than silently omitted.
Displayed data is known to be out of date relative to its source; the surface says so rather than presenting it as current.
The request failed; the specific cause is stated inline and the surface offers the action that retries it.

claims.statement: An infeasible profile is refused before any section is generated, naming the worst-case section and the resolved model's declared window.
claims.rationale: Stranding a document partway through is strictly worse than refusing it up front, because prior-section context accumulates as the document advances. (Tier: aspirational until the UI exists and accessibility captures can join these bindings; promote to machine at that point — the binding testids above are the contract the UI must satisfy.)

claims.statement: Before an already-committed section is rerolled, the sections that carried its text are named.
claims.rationale: Feed-forward context means a change upstream silently invalidates work downstream; the operator must see the blast radius before acting, not discover it after. (Tier: aspirational until the UI exists and accessibility captures can join these bindings; promote to machine at that point — the binding testids above are the contract the UI must satisfy.)

claims.statement: Cross-section coherence is reported as measured numbers rather than asserted as a verdict.
claims.rationale: Style drift across a document is a number — variance of per-section feature vectors — and stating it as a judgement would hide the evidence. (Tier: aspirational until the UI exists and accessibility captures can join these bindings; promote to machine at that point — the binding testids above are the contract the UI must satisfy.)

claims.statement: The outline is converged through the same candidate-set affordances as a section, not through a separate editor.
claims.rationale: The outline is an ordinary candidate; giving it a bespoke surface would duplicate the sampling and selection stack in the UI.
